items.prompt: Annual nominal r compounded m times yearly has which factor for supplied year fraction t?

options.why: Require a positive base and matching units.
That grows rather than discounts under positive r.

options.text: (1+r/m)^(-t), omitting the number of compounding periods in the exponent
options.why: There are m*t compounding periods under the stated annual nominal convention.

items.explanation: The compounding frequency belongs in both the base and exponent.
